main_body: desert mud-brick house with flat terraced roof
top_band: sandy tan roof terrace with parapet walls, rug, and roof hatch from rows 0 to 31
evidence: Rows 0-31 show a full 3/4 view of the flat roof terrace bounded by parapet walls (showing inner back shadow at rows 3-5, roof surface at rows 6-27, and front parapet at rows 28-31). Row 30 is a bright highlight line on the front roof edge, followed by a dark eave shadow at rows 32-33, and the vertical front wall from rows 32-63 with an inset arched doorway (shadowed at row 41) and recessed window.

style.evidence: The mud-brick wall and sandy roof feature rich plaster speckle, exposed brick patches, roof beams, and multi-step warm brown/tan ramps. Outlines use dark brown material tones rather than black, matching the Beodeul quality standard well.
